summary: Phase 4: drill profiles + scoring refinement. Drill profiles are now first-class Dexie records (schema v3, `profiles` table) with full CRUD via Settings → Profile (Active / New / Rename / Delete; cannot delete the only remaining profile). Each profile owns a complete `DrillConfig` — `SettingsRecord` is now slim (just `commitKeyCode / commitKeyLabel / inputSource / activeProfileId`) and Phase 2/3 settings rows are migrated into a seeded `Default` profile via `readLegacySettingsOverrides` on first run. `loadActiveProfile` uses an in-flight promise singleton so React StrictMode double-mount cannot double-seed. The classifier now treats `lateThresholdMs` as a first-class threshold distinct from `responseWindowMs` (defaults: hesitation 450 / late 600 / response-window 1200); presses in [hesitationThresholdMs, lateThresholdMs) are hesitation, presses in [lateThresholdMs, responseWindowMs] are late. Scoring weights are configurable per profile (default unchanged from Phase 1 SCORE_TABLE). `allowedCueIds` lets a profile subset the library; `pickNextCue` and `validateDrillConfig` honor it. Summary screen now shows a per-cue breakdown (reps / correct / FS / hes / late / avg-RT / best-10-RT) plus a rhythm-pattern narrative via the new pure `antiRhythmSignal` helper. 21 new tests added (81 total, all green): late-threshold boundaries, cue-subset filtering + validation, threshold-ordering validation, scoring-weight plumbing, `cueBreakdown` counts + best-10, `antiRhythmSignal` bucketing + narrative spike, profile CRUD, `loadActiveProfile` migration of legacy drill fields. Reviewer APPROVED after one round of changes (DRY fix stripping drill fields from SettingsRecord); qa-playwright PASS on all 6 acceptance criteria + Phase 3 regression; both defects QA found during the first pass (StrictMode double-seed, settings-state staleness on profile switch) are fixed and re-verified PASS with zero console errors.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: User can create / edit / save drill profiles
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C1 — New/Rename/Delete via Settings → Profile section worked end-to-end; deleting the only remaining profile shows the expected error banner

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Configurable per-profile: cue set, delay range, late threshold, hesitation threshold, response window, scoring weights, round structure, distance axis
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C2 — Sparring profile round-trip preserved rounds=2, work=3s, rest=2s, hesitation=400, late=700, response-window=1500, distance axis ON across switch-away-and-back

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Hesitation detection uses an explicit, configurable RT band
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: drill.test.ts boundary tests at hesitationThresholdMs, lateThresholdMs-1, lateThresholdMs; validateDrillConfig enforces hesitation ≤ late ≤ responseWindow
DEFAULT_DRILL_CONFIG ships hesitationThresholdMs=450, lateThresholdMs=600, responseWindowMs=1200; SettingsScreen 'Choice-RT thresholds' section exposes all three

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Per-cue-type RT and error-rate breakdown in summary
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C5 — Summary table shows Cue · Reps · Correct · FS · Hes · Late · Avg RT · Best-10 RT with ≥3 cue rows populated; cueBreakdown unit-tested for counts and best-10 averaging

qa-playwright C6 — Rhythm pattern panel renders narrative; antiRhythmSignal unit-tested for empty/quiet, bucket arithmetic across a known sequence, and narrative spike when one bucket exceeds the global rate by ≥1.5×

gates.testing: 81/81 vitest tests pass (was 60 at Phase 3 boundary; 21 new). Every new public behavior has a primary-path + edge-case test, including the migration path from a Phase 2/3 settings row into a seeded Default profile carrying the user's prior config.
gates.dry: Drill-config invariants live in exactly one place after Phase 4: each profile owns its DrillConfig; SettingsRecord is slim; loadSettings/saveSettings strip legacy fields on read AND on write so the two cannot diverge. validateDrillConfig is the only place enforcing the threshold-ordering rule. scoreWeights flow from config → classifyRep, not duplicated. Reviewer round 1 raised this exact concern (drill fields previously double-shipped on SettingsRecord + ProfileRecord.config) and APPROVED after the fix.
gates.drift: Phase 1/2/3 patterns preserved cleanly. RepRecord schema unchanged. SessionRecord schema unchanged. Older Phase 1/2/3 sessions still summarize and render in the new per-cue table because cueBreakdown reads only from RepRecord.cueId.
gates.planning: decision-memo.md rewritten for Phase 4; planning gate triggered by cross-layer change (engine + persistence schema bump to v3 + UI + migration).
gates.verification_sprint: Re-ran lint + tsc + 60/60 tests at the Phase 3 boundary before any Phase 4 code was added. qa-playwright Phase 3 regression also passed (SVG cue pictographs, rest cycle, summary still work with all toggles default).
gates.pre_commit_verify: scripts/phasekit-verify.sh runs lint + typecheck + tests; gate intact since Phase 1.

review.code_reviewer_initial: REQUEST_CHANGES — one blocking issue (drill fields duplicated between SettingsRecord and DrillConfig)
fixes_applied: Stripped drill fields from SettingsRecord; SettingsRecord is now slim (id, commitKeyCode, commitKeyLabel, inputSource, activeProfileId?). LegacySettingsFields names the Phase 2/3 shape for migration only.
loadSettings normalizes legacy rows on read; saveSettings explicitly writes only the slim shape so stale fields are stripped on next round-trip.
Added settings.test.ts migration test asserting that a stored Phase 3 row with non-default drill fields seeds a Default profile carrying those exact values (reviewer's specific recommended test).
QA-flagged: StrictMode double-seed of Default profile — loadActiveProfile now uses an in-flight promise singleton; QA re-verified exactly one Default in the dropdown after IDB clear + reload.

QA-flagged: profile switch reverting on Save — SettingsScreen handleSwitchProfile/handleCreateProfile/handleDeleteProfile now also update local settings state; QA re-verified the Save persists the new active profile id.
review.code_reviewer_final: APPROVE — blocking finding resolved, no new DRY concerns
review.qa_playwright: PASS — all 6 Phase 4 criteria + Phase 3 regression + re-verification of both defect fixes. Zero console errors. Evidence in artifacts/phase4-verify/ and artifacts/phase4-reverify/.
